name: Amalfi: Renaissance

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the fourth period

categories.label: Victory points on score track
categories.labelVi: VP trên track (đã gồm Decree, phạt Feed, Titles)
categories.hint: Decree VP each period, Feed penalty (-3 per unpaid coin), Titles and other VP are already on the track; can be negative.

categories.label: Invited characters (VP, capped per card)
categories.labelVi: Nhân vật đã mời (VP, có giới hạn mỗi thẻ)
categories.hint: Per invited character: VP per matching item owned, up to that card's maximum. Enter capped VP of each card.

categories.label: Cubes on Titles (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Cubes you placed on completed Titles.

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, the tied players share the win.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Only the characters' VP is counted at the end; all other VP (Decree each period, Titles worth up to 24 and 12, Feed penalty of 3 VP per missing coin, immediate rewards) are scored on the track during play. Characters' per-card maximum is printed on the card; scorer enters capped VP. Solo/co-op modes not modelled.
